hooks.name: Check MCP Server Venv
hooks.description: Checks if the olive-mcp-server Python venv exists and has deps installed on session start. Warns if setup is needed.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$py = $null; if (Test-Path 'olive-mcp-server/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') { $py = 'olive-mcp-server/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' } elseif (Test-Path 'olive-mcp-server/.venv/bin/python') { $py = 'olive-mcp-server/.venv/bin/python' }; if (-not $py) { Write-Output 'WARNING: Olive MCP Server venv not found. Run: .\\scripts\\setup-mcp.ps1 (or ./scripts/setup-mcp.sh on Linux/macOS) to set up the MCP server with semantic search support.' } else { & $py -c 'import mcp; print(mcp.__version__)' 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'WARNING: MCP server deps may be incomplete. Run: .\\scripts\\setup-mcp.ps1 (or ./scripts/setup-mcp.sh) to reinstall.' } }"
